# Wide code in English

A note in English takes a narrower measure, so a block of code is wide sooner here than it would be in a note in Chinese.

## Fits the measure

```go
func fits() {
	log.Println("the serializable transaction gave up....")
}
```

## Fits the measure at the base size

```go
func base() {
	log.Println("the serializable transaction gave up after.")
}
```

## One character more

```go
func past() {
	log.Println("the serializable transaction gave up after..")
}
```

The text after the block.
